title: I'm trying to make a hit concept. Blade Dancer
author: MD1990X
selftext:
Hey all - just wanted to post this up to see what you guys think as gamers and if this is a compelling mechanic to build a game around.

I'm using an automatic swinging sword combined with mouse control to have a game where you make every single attack your own - paired with a chakram you can whack with the sword! 

It's going to be a roguelite game that's very focused on just having fun and playing the game, outside of the runs, everything is just menu based to that you're focused on playing and crafting is totally there and present but you're not playing walking simulator 2026. 

Also thanks for this place, I've been so sad that you literally just can't post anything AI related. I'm so excited to just focus on making great games =)

comments.author: chereth__cutestory
comments.body: Looks great. I think the freeze/slow down for impact is slightly too pronounced? idk
